description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stangg, adding {C}{C}.
When Stangg dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Stangg from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Stangg enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 3/4 Stangg Twin creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Stangg Twin, adding {C}{C}.
When the Stangg Twin token dies, Stangg triggers.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
